scope.boundary: Requirements only; actual evidence remains in operator-owned evidence storage.

controls.title: Authoritative Postgres trust-state ownership
controls.retention_policy: Retain schema, backup, and access-review evidence for the operator-defined audit window.
controls.why_required: Production scanners cannot trust derived cache state unless durable governance state has an owned source of truth.

controls.title: Migration ledger and rollback review
controls.retention_policy: Retain migration approvals, checksums, and rollback rehearsal records with release evidence.
controls.why_required: Trust-state schema changes must be replayable, auditable, and reversible before production traffic depends on them.

controls.title: Restore automation proof
controls.retention_policy: Retain the most recent successful backup, scratch restore, and failover drill evidence.
controls.why_required: An operator cannot claim production readiness if root, issuer, policy, or cache state cannot be restored under controlled conditions.

controls.title: Packaged deployment approval chain
controls.retention_policy: Retain artifact provenance, promotion approval, security review, operations review, and rollback acceptance for each promoted release.
controls.why_required: A scanner-facing trust service should only run artifacts that have explicit release ownership and rollback acceptance.

controls.title: Propagation broker ownership
controls.retention_policy: Retain broker configuration, stream retention, subject ACL, and replay drill evidence for the operator-defined audit window.
controls.why_required: Propagation accelerates verifier updates but must not become an unowned or unaudited source of trust.

controls.title: Managed key-material custody
controls.retention_policy: Retain managed key inventory, rotation ceremony, and access review evidence according to the custody policy.
controls.why_required: Production signing keys must be managed through owned custody controls rather than fixture, filesystem, or environment-only signing material.

controls.title: Managed signing operation custody
controls.retention_policy: Retain signing provider configuration, signer identity mapping, and approval workflow evidence.
controls.why_required: Issuer and status artifacts need an auditable signing path that does not expose signing secrets to application code or public repositories.

controls.title: Public-safe custody audit export
controls.retention_policy: Retain redacted custody audit exports and review decisions for every promoted signer or release.
controls.why_required: Reviewers need to verify custody posture without receiving signing material or provider secrets.

controls.title: Runtime safety provider operation
controls.retention_policy: Retain provider health, stale-data policy, and fail-closed drill evidence.
controls.why_required: Present-time destination safety is a separate trust layer and cannot be inferred from successful QR decoding or signature validation.

controls.title: Scanner decision persistence and auditability
controls.retention_policy: Retain sampled scanner decision logs and privacy review evidence without storing unnecessary payload data.
controls.why_required: Scanner-visible green, orange, and red states need reviewable reason codes and privacy-preserving audit behavior.

controls.title: Always-on worker operations evidence
controls.retention_policy: Retain worker supervisor reports, lag metrics, and recovery drills for each runtime component.
controls.why_required: Publication, propagation, cache materialization, and scanner-decision workers must be observable and recoverable before they support production trust decisions.

controls.title: Operator runbook and escalation readiness
controls.retention_policy: Retain current runbook review and escalation contact records with release evidence.
controls.why_required: The QR trust network needs human-operable procedures for key incidents, verifier cache staleness, provider outage, restore, and rollback.
